title: Broken image path
symptom: The hero image shows a broken icon. Console is clean; Network tab shows a red 404 for images/hero.png.
hints: Look at the Network tab: what exact URL was requested?
Compare it with the folder listing, including capitalization.
cause: The path is wrong: folder is images/ (plural) and the filename case differs. Servers on Linux are case sensitive.
verify: Reload with cache disabled: the request returns 200 and no red rows remain in Network.

title: Specificity bug
symptom: The .btn is styled blue in CSS, but the button stays grey.
hints: Open Elements → Styles and look for a struck-through rule.
fix: Lower the first selector (.actions button) or raise the second (#actions .btn). Avoid !important.
verify: DevTools shows the blue rule applied and not struck through.

title: Mobile overflow
symptom: At 360px a horizontal scrollbar appears and one card sticks out.
hints: Device toolbar → 360px. Hover elements to find the widest.
Check fixed widths and padding with box-sizing.
cause: Fixed width wider than the viewport.

title: Input with no label
symptom: A screen reader announces 'edit text' with no name; clicking the text near the input does nothing.
hints: Which element connects text to an input?
verify: Clicking the label focuses the input; Accessibility tree shows the name 'Email'.

title: Silent fetch failure
symptom: Weather widget stays empty when the city is wrong or offline. No error is visible.
hints: What does fetch do with a 404?
cause: Empty catch hides errors and non-2xx responses are not treated as errors.
verify: Network offline in DevTools shows the error state with Retry.

title: Handler attached twice
hints: How many times is addEventListener called?
Look at where it is called.
cause: Listener added on every render call.
fix: Attach once at startup (or use a delegated listener outside render).
verify: One click adds exactly one item; getEventListeners(list) shows one click listener.
